system.description: • Effect: Choose one specific creature type as favoured enemy (GM should require a creature encountered repeatedly in the character's history). Against this enemy: your first hit each round deals an extra weapon damage die and ignores its resistance, it can't hide from you, and you have +2 AC and +2 to tracking checks, and the ranger can neutralise their manufactured poisons as well as natural ones.

rules.value: Favoured Enemy: your first hit each round deals an extra weapon damage die and ignores its resistance.
